hero.heading: Bring Your Community or Business to Spellful
hero.subheading: Organizations on Spellful include shops, studios, collectives, event hosts, nonprofits, learning organizations, and community groups — any entity that serves the broader magical community.

typesSection.heading: What Kinds of Organizations Join?
typesSection.subheading: From independent metaphysical shops to large spiritual education platforms, organizations of all sizes are welcome.

creatorCta.heading: Creating content as an individual?
creatorCta.subheading: Individual creators have their own dedicated profile type.
